params.name: type

params.description: Allows for the filtering of plans based on whether the current time is within the period of time defined as effective by the _effectiveFrom_ and _effectiveTo_ fields. Valid values are `CURRENT`, `FUTURE` and `ALL`. If absent defaults to `CURRENT`.

params.name: updated-since
